candidate.title: Admin group edit form implicitly submits on Enter, causing full page reload and lost unsaved changes
reports: in group.hbs, buttons inside <form class="form-horizontal"> lack type="button", so pressing enter in the name field natively submits the form (full page reload) instead of running the ember save action

the new <form class="form-horizontal"> wrapper in the admin group template has no submit-event handler: pressing enter in the group-name text field or user-selector triggers a native form submission to the current url, causing a full page reload that discards all unsaved edits

new <form> wrapper in the admin group template: pressing enter in the group-name field or user-selector input triggers native implicit form submission to the current url — a full page reload that discards unsaved edits, since only the save/delete buttons' {{action}} handlers preventdefault

[bug] the new <form class="form-horizontal"> wraps the group-name text field and the user-selector input while every button inside it lacks type="button", so pressing enter in either input performs native form submission. the admin types a group name (or a username in the selector) and presses enter; the browser submits the form as a get to the current url and performs a full page reload, discarding every unsaved edit — name, visibility, alias level — with no save and no error.
